notes: Contributor workflow (CONTRIBUTING.md:29-40): cd examples/base && go run main.go serve, which serves on http://localhost:8090 with the prebuilt Superuser UI embedded from the committed ui/dist. SQLite is embedded, so no services and no env file are needed. No separate dependency step is documented; module download happens inside go run / go build (recorded as install:go). The second dev entry (Vite UI dev server on :5173, which expects the backend at :8090 unless PB_BACKEND_URL is set in ui/.env.development.local, CONTRIBUTING.md:78-81) is only needed for Superuser UI work and requires 'npm install' in ui/ first. readmeCommands come from README 'Building and running the repo main.go example' and must run inside examples/base (README says 'Navigate to examples/base' in prose); the 'Use as a Go framework' section (go mod init myapp, go run main.go serve) is for a new project, not this repo, and is excluded. Versions: Go 1.27 (go.mod directive, README, CONTRIBUTING); Node 24+ per CONTRIBUTING.md:17, while CI asks for >=25.2.1 and Go >=1.27.3. CONTRIBUTING calls the UI 'Svelte and Vite', but ui/README.md and package.json show Shablon + Vite (no Svelte). README.md:1 says the repo has moved to ganigeorgiev.com/pocketbase/pocketbase, and PRs are restricted to collaborators.
